trigger_condition.value_trigger: alpha scalar outside float16 representable range, e.g. ~1e32
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: tensors dtype float16; scalar alpha > float16 max; run identical operation on CPU and CUDA

root_cause.backend_layer: Inconsistent backend handling of scalar-to-float16 overflow between CPU and CUDA

bug_oracle.description: CPU raises RuntimeError for alpha conversion overflow to Half while CUDA succeeds silently. The oracle is a CPU/CUDA behavior mismatch for the same float16 input.
bug_oracle.signal: RuntimeError: value cannot be converted to type at::Half without overflow

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate alpha around float16 overflow boundaries, including values near max finite 65504 and far beyond it
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct float16 tensors with arbitrary or random shapes and values
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force dtype=torch.float16 and inject alpha values that overflow float16
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.add(tensor1, tensor2, alpha=extreme_scalar) on CPU and CUDA with identical inputs
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare exception presence and execution status between CPU and CUDA; flag any mismatch
